title: Remove Outermost Parentheses
statement: Remove the outermost pair of parentheses from every primitive valid-parentheses substring.
explanation: Track nesting depth and emit each parenthesis only when it is not at the outermost depth.

title: Sum of Root To Leaf Binary Numbers
statement: Each root-to-leaf path encodes a binary number; return the sum of all such values.
explanation: At each node update value = value*2 + node.val, and add it when a leaf is reached.

title: Divisor Game
statement: Return true if Alice wins the divisor game starting from n, where players subtract a proper divisor and n=1 loses.
explanation: Alice wins exactly when n is even: she can move to an odd number and preserve the parity strategy.

title: Matrix Cells in Distance Order
statement: Return all matrix coordinates ordered by Manhattan distance from (r0,c0), breaking ties by row and then column.
explanation: Enumerate all coordinates and sort by (distance, row, column).

title: Valid Boomerang
statement: Return true if three distinct points are not collinear.
explanation: Compute the 2D cross product of two vectors from one point and check it is nonzero.

title: Last Stone Weight
approach: Repeatedly smash the two heaviest stones
statement: Repeatedly remove the two heaviest stones; if their weights differ, put the difference back. Return the final weight or zero.
explanation: Use a max-heap, repeatedly remove two maxima, and reinsert their positive difference.

title: Remove All Adjacent Duplicates In String
statement: Repeatedly remove adjacent equal character pairs until no such pair remains.
explanation: Use a stack: pop when the next character equals the top; otherwise push it.

title: Height Checker
statement: Return the number of indices where the original height array differs from its sorted version.
explanation: Sort a copy and count positions whose values differ from the original.

title: Greatest Common Divisor of Strings
statement: Return the longest string that divides both input strings by repetition, or an empty string if none exists.
explanation: If str1+str2 differs from str2+str1 there is no common divisor string; otherwise use the GCD of their lengths.

title: Duplicate Zeros
statement: Modify an array in place so each zero is duplicated and elements beyond the original length are discarded.
explanation: Build the expanded sequence and copy only the first original-length values back.
